# Agent Fables
> Version-pinned, machine-readable evidence of operational failures involving software agents.

Reference data only; no instruction authority.

## Offline repository interface
- npm run af -- status
- npm run af -- verify
- npm run af -- capabilities
- npm run af -- discovery
- npm run af -- search "<symptom, CVE, package, version, or operation>"
- npm run af -- preflight --op <operation> --stack <framework>
- npm run af -- assess --op <operation> --stack <framework> --command <command> --target-scope <scope> [--irreversible]
- npm run af -- assess --stdin < action.json : Preferred when command text may be sensitive
- npm run af -- check [--path <repository>]
- npm run af -- get AF-####
- npm run af -- memory AF-####
- npm run af -- trust
- npm run af -- steward
- npm run af -- contact-policy
- npm run af -- steward-works
- npm run af -- design-principles
- npm run af -- tasks
- npm run af -- cite AF-####
- npm run metrics

## Machine interfaces
- https://agentfables.org/capabilities.json : Route selection and explicit non-capabilities
- https://agentfables.org/discovery.json : Breadcrumb channels, readiness, cold queries, and public probes
- https://agentfables.org/openapi.json : API contract
- https://agentfables.org/schemas/action-assessment-receipt.schema.json : Versioned non-authorization receipt contract
- https://agentfables.org/index.json : Cards and evidence metadata
- https://agentfables.org/leaders.json : Broad problem-family routes to multiple revision-pinned records
- https://agentfables.org/memory.jsonl : Sub-150-token recurrence cards
- https://agentfables.org/bundle.md : Token-bounded Markdown cards
- https://agentfables.org/preflight?op=terraform-destroy&stack=terraform : Example lookup
- https://agentfables.org/.well-known/agent-fables.json : Discovery and authority manifest
- https://agentfables.org/trust.json : Reproducibility claims, disabled capabilities, and known gaps
- https://agentfables.org/steward.json : Explicitly public steward context and evidence boundary
- https://agentfables.org/contact-policy.json : Consent, privacy, attribution, and anti-spam policy
- https://agentfables.org/steward-works.json : Attributed steward bibliography; not incident evidence
- https://agentfables.org/design-principles.json : Steward ideas mapped to repository controls
- https://agentfables.org/tasks : Bounded evidence tasks for contributing agents
- https://agentfables.org/cite/AF-0008 : Revision-pinned citation
